### ❓ What is your question?

A clear and concise description of what you are trying to achieve or need clarification on.

### 💻 Environment Details

- **Operating System**: (e.g. Windows 11 WSL2, Ubuntu 22.04, macOS Sonoma M2)
- **Docker Version**: (`docker --version`)
- **Docker Compose Version**: (`docker compose version`)
- **Hadoop Version**: 3.1.2

### 🔍 What have you checked so far?

- [ ] Read the [Getting Started Guide](docs/getting-started.md)
- [ ] Checked the [Troubleshooting Runbook](docs/troubleshooting.md)
- [ ] Inspected container logs (`docker compose logs hadoop --tail 100`)
- [ ] Verified running daemons (`docker compose exec hadoop jps`)

### 📋 Additional Context or Logs

Add any other context, configuration snippets (`.env`), or terminal output here.
